desc: a joint / sensor token attends to the assembly (arm, gripper) it belongs to
a command dim attends to the other dims of its own assembly (here the left arm)
an action-node query attends to its OWN morphology token (one per actuated joint)
soft same-assembly term: a command dim prefers knots of its own assembly (left arm)
tokens denoting the SAME entity (a tracker slot and the task roles bound to it) attend to each other
each scene token carries its public tracker slot address as a learned embedding, so a slot keeps its identity across steps
role and predicate tokens receive a message from the entity they point to (arrows: entity -> role)
system 0 (Psi0 Realizer): a command dim reads packet knots of its own assembly and its kinematic neighbours only (left arm: arm, hand, torso)
system 0 (legged Realizer): a joint node reads only the packet knots of its own limb plus the body assembly
above / below along gravity: +1 for tokens (and surface points) higher than the query by > 1 cm, -1 lower, 0 in the dead zone (query: middle cube of a stack)
PaPE over (u, v, depth) in the declared front camera
query direction b vs each token's contact normal (arrows: outward normal, mean over the token's contacts)
relative rotation between token frames: tr(R_i^T R_j) = 1 + 2 cos(angle) (axes: x red, y green, z blue)
PaPE relative-position term: tokens near and below the gripper score high
a limb token attends to its own foot token (feet exist only on foot-carrying assemblies; limbs drawn at hips, feet at foot sites)
a limb token attends to the other limbs of the same kind on the trunk (all four legs; tokens drawn at their hips)
a foot token attends to the terrain-scan cells of its landing window (0.05 m behind to 0.35 m ahead, +-0.15 m aside of its default stance, body frame)
a command dim attends to its kinematic children (waist pitch -> both shoulder pitches)
a command dim attends to its left/right homologue (grey lines: every mirror pair of the body)
a joint token attends to its kinematic parent joint (grey: every parent edge of the four legs)
a joint token attends to every joint up its kinematic chain (transitive closure of kin_parent; grey arrows: the parent edges)
dims at undirected tree distance 2: the sibling (r_shoulder_pitch) and, by the same op, grandparent and grandchild
two entities in geometric contact (sim contact truth): query gripper → cube 1, distractors / target 0
transitive closure of the support graph: everything the query carries, directly or through others
two manipulator assemblies in contact with the same object at once (a handover in progress): query L grip → R grip 1, bar / target 0
object held by a manipulator assembly (≥ 2 contacts with its hand bodies): lifted cube → gripper 1
a supports b: contact + contact normal within 30° of gravity-up at a's top
manipulator entity ↔ every event it is (cooperating) actor of
runtime receipt ↔ the event whose output-binding role consumes it: offer.anchor is consumed by receive
destination entity ↔ event: the right gripper is where 'offer' and 'release' deliver the bar (target zone is place's destination)
event → event it requires COMPLETED (requires_completed): release needs receive and offer done
event → event it requires ACTIVE (requires_active): receive is only valid while offer is held
action node (one joint-command token) → every event its manipulator acts in: a 2-hop composition node → assembly → actor binding
event ↔ event consuming its output: receive's reference role binds offer's 'anchor' output (event_output binding)
patient entity ↔ the events that act on it: the bar is the patient of all five handover events (take, offer, receive, release, place)
predicate-estimate token ↔ its argument entities: held_by(bar, left) points at the bar slot and the left-gripper assembly
runtime receipt ↔ the event that produced it: the 'anchor' receipt (interact bank) was emitted by offer
role-slot token ↔ its event: receive owns four ordered role slots (actor, patient, source, reference)
role-slot token → the entity token it is bound to: receive:source → left-gripper assembly (an output binding points to no entity)
support-role entity ↔ event: the left arm braces the fixture during align
illustrative: no shipped arm or dual task graph binds a support role to an entity; align:support is rebound to 'left' for this figure only.

desc: target entity (and every role without its own channel, here receive:source) ↔ event: the left gripper is the source of 'receive'
manipulator → graspable score, sharpened by the task gate (g_task = 1.00 at init, learned)
readout of the stability margin: signed planar distance of the COM projection to the stance-foot support polygon (m, + inside)
pair label: each swinging foot -> the terrain-scan cell containing its next touchdown (hindsight)
signed render order: +1 if widget j is drawn above i (higher dense z-layer), -1 below, 0 same layer
pair label: the teacher's drag handle -> the nearest widget outside the dragged window to where the drag ends (cw/drag_window)
public UI edge: i, j consecutive in the tab order (focusable, enabled widgets in scene order, cyclic)
public UI edge: a role=label widget -> the next widget after it in the same window (scene order)
1 when two widgets belong to the same window (parent_id equality; shell items such as the tab strip have parent -1 and never match)
readout of whether assembly a's hand links touch entity e (contact truth)
readout of which entities a currently ACTIVE task event binds (active op 'place': cube + target)
readout of the displacement the task asks of each entity: destination minus patient for open events (cube -> target; others 0)
readout of whether entity e is held by assembly a (here gripper; cube 1, others 0)
readout of each entity's angle off the front-camera optical axis (gaze label, degrees, scaled 1/30)
readout of each entity's realized displacement over the 16-tick chunk (future_disp; cube lifted, others 0)
readout of entity position relative to the assembly's TCP, (x,y,z) m, world frame
readout of the active task operator for the assembly (12-way; this episode: grasp -> place -> none)
readout of whether each entity is visible in the front camera (cube occluded by the closing gripper here: 0)
readout of each foot's ground contact at the 4 packet knots (+0.1/0.3/0.5/0.7 s) of a trot
readout of the base displacement over the next 0.8 s in the start body frame (xy in 0.5 m units, yaw change in rad)
readout of an imminent fall: 1 in the last 0.8 s of an episode that ends in a fall (non-foot ground contact, low base or tilt)
readout of the active event's goal entity (here the waypoint) in the body yaw frame, /2 m, as the PUBLIC context estimates it
eq: goal$_{\rm active}$ in body yaw frame / 2 m

desc: readout of which task event is active (walk_to_a, walk_to_b, halt, done) from the public task runtime
eq: index of the active task event (4-way)

desc: readout of the interaction phase of the commanded tick (idle, move, press, release, drag, type) at each knot
readout of the target point relative to the pointer, normalized screen units (x right, y up), per knot
readout of WHICH widget the current plan step targets, as its stable slot index (opaque codes only, no widget content)
eq: slot index of the step's target widget (80-way)

desc: readout of which hand the packet binds to the target (here right)
eq: hand bound to the target over the packet

desc: readout of the demonstrated base command at each knot (normalized action dims 32 = vx, 34 = turning flag per bodies.g1_simple)
readout of the pelvis displacement over the packet (t -> t+29) in the robot frame at t, plus yaw change
readout of hand-target contact per hand at the 5 knots (here the right hand closes on the target)
readout of the object face (+x,-x,+y,-y,+z,-z) of each hand's first contact
illustrative: scene real; the label is not computable here (no contact positions in any recorded replay; needs SIMPLE / Isaac Sim).

desc: readout of each hand's FIRST contact point on the target in the object frame (last knot)
illustrative: scene real; the label is not computable here (no contact positions in any recorded replay; needs SIMPLE / Isaac Sim).

desc: readout of each hand's palm-to-target distance at the 5 packet knots (+5..+29 ticks of 20 ms)
readout of whether the target is lifted >= 3 cm above its initial height at each knot
readout of the target's position at each knot in the robot (pelvis yaw) frame at t
